environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x deployed on EC2 with SoftHSM2 (software-based PKCS#11 emulator). Keys are stored in SoftHSM token files on local EBS volume. The application runs as root with JVM debug port 5005 open. Log output goes to stdout captured by systemd journal. No input validation middleware. The HSM PIN is stored in application.properties in plaintext. SoftHSM stores extractable key objects by default (CKA_EXTRACTABLE=true, CKA_SENSITIVE=false on the token).
